
# Tomás Durães

> Personal portfolio of Tomás Durães, a programming student and junior developer interested in backend development, Linux, macOS and computer systems.

## About

Tomás Durães is a programming student interested in software development, operating systems and the relationship between hardware and software.

He enjoys experimenting with different technologies, configuring Linux environments, exploring macOS on non-Apple hardware and learning how computer systems work.

His technical interests include backend development, Linux system configuration, macOS, computer hardware and software troubleshooting.

## Development Approach

Tomás uses AI-assisted development tools to explore ideas, prototype features and support implementation.

AI-generated code is treated as a starting point rather than a finished product. He reviews, tests and refines it as part of his development process.

This approach is also referred to as AI-assisted development or vibe coding.

## Projects

- [NixOS Configuration](https://github.com/quicktommy/nixos-config): Personal declarative NixOS configuration featuring Nix Flakes, a customized Hyprland desktop and Noctalia. Focused on reproducibility, modularity and maintainability.

- [Hackintosh Tahoe EFI](https://github.com/quicktommy/IdeaPad-Gaming-3-15ARH05-Hackintosh): OpenCore EFI project for running macOS Tahoe on a Lenovo IdeaPad Gaming 3 15ARH05 with an AMD Ryzen 5 4600H. Includes separate Recovery and Full EFI setups and Intel AX210 Wi-Fi and Bluetooth support.

## Technical Interests & Technologies

- Operating Systems: Linux, NixOS, macOS
- Desktop & Customization: Hyprland, Noctalia, Zsh
- System Configuration: Nix Flakes, declarative configuration
- Hackintosh: OpenCore, EFI
- Development Tools: Git, GitHub
- Other Interests: Backend development, computer systems, hardware troubleshooting
- Development Approach: AI-assisted development, prototyping, code review and testing

## Currently Learning

- Rust: Exploring the language and learning its fundamentals.
- SQL: Learning basic SQL syntax, queries and database concepts.
